# MEMORANDUM

| **TO:** | Atty. Bonifacio T. Barandon, Jr., Barandon Law Offices, Daet |
|---|---|
| **FROM:** | Jonathan Paul Zschoche, attorney-in-fact of plaintiff Patricia Keesey Zschoche |
| **DATE:** | 12 October 2026 |
| **RE:** | Civil Case No. 26-360 (Zschoche v. Balane et al.), MTC Mercedes — decisions needed before my testimony on Wednesday, 14 October 2026, 1:30 PM; corrections to our papers; findings from the record for cross-examination and argument |

Privileged and confidential attorney–client communication. Prepared for counsel's review. Not for filing. Where I state a view on the law, it is a layman's reading for your verification, not a position I will take on the stand.

Atty. Barandon, this memorandum gathers everything I need your decision on before Wednesday, in one place. Part A lists the decisions. Part B lists corrections to our own papers. Part C sets out what I found on re-reading our exhibits and theirs. Part D is the forgery question. Part E is how I intend to answer on the stand, so you can correct me now rather than in court. Annex 1 is a draft Manifestation on the errata; Annex 2 is a draft supplemental judicial affidavit, if you decide to seek leave.
